title: The fan in the window
logline: A box fan in the garage's casement window in July, from the alley, turning, the jars moved to the table for it. A back in plaid beyond it at the table. Summer as a machine.

panels.composition: A box fan set in a garage's open casement window seen from the alley, blades blurred, three jars visible on a table inside beside a man's back in plaid.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a box fan set in a garage's open casement window seen from an alley with its blades blurred, three jars on a table inside beside a man's back in plaid flannel, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
